'''Athgar Heece''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Dybrinthe]] [[bounty hunter]] who operated in the [[Niima Outpost]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Jakku]] during the reign of the [[New Republic]]. Heece was used to living on worlds with higher [[Atmosphere|atmospheric]] pressures and [[temperature]]s than Jakku, so Jakku seemed quite pleasant to Heece. Heece wore [[Color|brown]] [[Clothing|robes]] with a hose that supplied processed atmosphere.

During the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]], Heece was in the Niima Outpost waiting in a line to sell junk to the [[junk boss]] [[Unkar Plutt]] shortly before the outpost was partially razed by [[First Order]] [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE/fo fighters]] in an unrelated mission. Heece later made a posting in [[Black Spire Outpost]] on the [[planet]] [[Batuu]] looking for someone to help locate an [[osteo fragmenter]]. A traveler agreed to help and Heece transferred them a set of [[Praetorian Guard|Elite Praetorian Guard]] armor after the job was completed.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Perfect. I'd try finding one in a crate near Savi's Workshop.|Heece messages a traveler about finding a fragmenter|<ref name="Datapad" />}}
[[File:Athgar_Heece_and_Rey_on_Jakku.png|thumb|left|250px|Athgar Heece (far left) waits in line to sell junk to Unkar Plutt]]
[[Reproduction|Born]] in around [[0 ABY]],<ref name="Birth Date" /> Athgar Heece was a [[Gender|male]] member of the [[Dybrinthe]] [[species]]<ref name="Datapad" /> from the [[Deep Core]] [[moon]] of [[Dybrin 12]]<ref name="Aliens of the Galaxy" /> who operated as a [[bounty hunter]] during the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]]. Heece operated on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Jakku]], and as Dybrinthe are accustomed to higher pressures and atmospheric conditions, Heece was one of Jakku's few visitors who found the world's [[atmosphere]] pleasant.<ref name="TFAVD" />

During the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]], Heece was present in [[Niima Outpost]]. Alongside another Dybrinthe, Heece stood in a line to sell junk to the outpost's [[Crolute]] [[junk boss]] [[Unkar Plutt]]. An [[Abednedo]] and the [[human]] [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] stood in line ahead of Heece. While dealing with Rey, Plutt offered a lucrative trade deal for Rey's recently acquired [[droid]] [[BB-8]]. When Rey refused, Plutt angrily closed his shop, barring Heece from seeing the junkboss.<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref>

Later in the [[Standard day|day]], Heece was still in the settlement when the Niima Outpost was partially destroyed by [[First Order]] [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE/fo fighters]] when they gave [[Escape from Jakku|chase]] to Rey in their own attempt to capture BB-8.<ref name="TFA" /> Following the outbreak of the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the First Order and the [[Resistance]], Heece made a posting in [[Black Spire Outpost]] on the [[planet]] [[Batuu]] requesting someone who would ask no questions find an [[osteo fragmenter]], which were considered "off-limits". In exchange the Dybrinthe offered up a rare set of [[Praetorian Guard|Elite Praetorian Guard]] [[armor]]. A traveler visiting Batuu agreed to help, so Heece directed them to search near [[Savi's Workshop]]. After the traveler successfully located the fragmenter, Heece messaged them thanks and sent them the armor.<ref name="Datapad" />

==Personality and traits==
Athgar Heece was a tall individual who wore elaborate headgear while on Jakku which Heece wore to improve his breathing while away from Heece's [[homeworld]].<ref name="TFAVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Athgar Heece first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], which was released in [[2015]]. The character was not identified in the film, but received a name in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released the same day as the film. Behind-the-scenes photos posted on the TMZ website reveal that Athgar Heece was portrayed by a blond female extra, later identified as British artist [[Mel Pickup]].<ref name="Southport Visister">{{WebCite|url=https://www.southportvisiter.co.uk/whats-on/whats-on-news/star-wars-southport-couple-role-10610876|text=Southport couple's excitement at roles in Star Wars: The Force Awakens movie|author=Andrew Brown|date=2015-12-16|work=Southport Visiter|archivedate=20180706133820}}</ref>

In ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'', Heece is portrayed as being close friends with [[Lor San Tekka]].<ref name="Lego">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref>
